text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but I should not sell a stock merely to lock in a gain; decide based on its role in my overall portfolio.","I should judge each holding by its prospects and portfolio fit, not by whether it is above or below my average cost; refusing to admit a mistake can distort decisions.","Prices move unpredictably, so a few months of account changes do not establish a trend; avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and trade only for a clear reason."]}
